Appendicitis After Initiation of Tirzepatide. Tirzepatide is a GLP1/GIP receptor agonist that is used to treat type 2 diabetes and promote weight loss. Common side effects of Tirzepatide include nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea. More severe side effects include pancreatitis, cholelithiasis, thyroid cancer, and cholecystitis. results.text: A double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of exenatide for the treatment of olanzapine-related weight gain in obese and overweight adults. To assess the safety and efficacy of exenatide in overweight or obese patients treated with olanzapine. Adults with stable major mood or psychotic disorders were randomized to double-blind exenatide or placebo for 16 weeks. Weight and body mass index (BMI) were monitored throughout the study.
